newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.044pts to 103.201.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.044pts to 103.201.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.044 points in Tuesday's trading to 103.201, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.235 years.
The index can also be found on Reuters page .BICS.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, remained unchanged at 99.543 points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.174 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 0.944 points to 1,034.763.
